map.根据《中医体质分类与判定》（ZYYXH/T157-2009）标准，辨识九种基本体: Identify the nine basic constitution types according to the ZYYXH/T157-2009 standard Classification and Determination of TCM Body Constitution
map.按《中医体质分类与判定》标准：每种体质由对应条目按 5 级计分（1 至 5 分）: Per the Classification and Determination of TCM Body Constitution standard: each constitution is scored across its items on a 5-level scale (1 to 5 points), with conversion score = (raw score − number of items) ÷ (number of items × 4) × 100. A conversion score of 60 or above with all other constitutions below 30 is judged as that constitution (the balanced constitution uses the same rule of 60 or above with all others below 30); 40 or above but below 60 is a tendency toward that constitution.
map.📋 评分说明：每题5个选项（1-5分），1=没有(根本不)，2=很少(有一点)，: 📋 Scoring notes: each question has 5 options (1-5 points), 1 = never (not at all), 2 = rarely (a little), 3 = sometimes (sometimes), 4 = often (fairly), 5 = always (very much). Please answer based on your actual situation over the past year.
map.完成所有题目后点击「计算体质」: After completing all questions, click "Calculate constitution"
map.⚠️ 体质判定标准：转化分≥60分为\"是\"，40-59分为\"倾向是\"，<: ⚠️ Constitution determination standard: a conversion score of 60 or above means "yes", 40-59 means "tendency yes", and below 40 means "no". Multiple constitution tendencies may coexist (mixed constitution). This tool is for health reference only and cannot replace physician diagnosis.
map.📋 九种体质一览: 📋 The nine constitutions at a glance
map.体态适中，面色红润，精力旺盛: Well-proportioned build, rosy complexion and abundant energy

map.畏寒怕冷，手足不温: Aversion to cold, cold hands and feet
map.手足心热，口燥咽干: Hot palms and soles, dry mouth and throat
map.面垢油光，口苦苔黄: Greasy face and yellow tongue coating
map.肤色晦暗，易有瘀斑: Dull complexion and tendency to bruise
map.平和质转化分 75: A balanced constitution conversion score of 75
map.5 题均选 4 分→rawAvg=4，transScore=(4−1)/4×10: All 5 questions answered 4 → rawAvg=4, transScore=(4−1)/4×100=75, which is 60 or above so judged "yes"; if all answered 3 → (3−1)/4×100=50, judged "tendency yes".
map.含反向条目（如「容易疲乏」反向计 6−raw），raw=2 记 4 分，避免误判: Reverse items (such as "prone to fatigue" scored in reverse as 6−raw) record raw=2 as 4 points, avoiding a mistaken judgement of qi deficiency.
map.转化分公式？: What is the conversion score formula?
map.transScore=(各题均值−1)/4×100；≥60 是、40–59 倾向: transScore=(average of items−1)/4×100; 60 or above means yes, 40-59 means tendency yes, below 40 means no.
map.平和/气虚/阳虚/阴虚/痰湿/湿热/血瘀/气郁/特禀，报告列主次与偏颇。: Balanced, qi deficiency, yang deficiency, yin deficiency, phlegm-dampness, damp-heat, blood stasis, qi stagnation and inherent; the report lists the primary and secondary types with any deviations.
